We are looking for a cybersecurity professional with strong technical security expertise, at least one year of practical experience working with AI technologies, and the ability to apply established security principles to new and rapidly evolving technologies. This individual will work directly with clients to understand what they want to accomplish with AI, evaluate the associated cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and operational risks, and determine what must be addressed before implementation. They will then develop the path forward and personally perform the technical security and compliance work necessary to prepare the client's environment for secure adoption. Identify cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data-governance, and operational risks associated with proposed AI use cases. Identify existing security weaknesses that may create or amplify risk when AI is introduced. Evaluate risks associated with AI applications, agents, connectors, integrations, APIs, third-party services, and organizational data access. Review and remediate Microsoft 365 permissions, access controls, sharing configurations, and information-governance settings. Implement identity, access, data protection, application governance, monitoring, and compliance controls. Recommend Microsoft licensing changes, security add-ons, or additional technologies necessary to meet security requirements. Test and validate implemented configurations and remediate identified security weaknesses. Ensure required remediations are completed, tested, documented, and validated before an engagement is considered complete. Develop or recommend AI acceptable-use policies, standards, approval processes, and security requirements. Assist clients in defining approved and prohibited AI use cases. Evaluate enterprise versus consumer AI solutions from a cybersecurity and data-protection perspective. Assess how AI providers collect, retain, process, share, and potentially use organizational data. Evaluate security risks involving AI agents, automated actions, integrations, and access to organizational systems and information. Apply applicable cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance frameworks, including NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, HIPAA, CMMC, CJIS, and others as appropriate. Stay current on AI technologies, enterprise AI platforms, cybersecurity threats, Microsoft security capabilities, and regulatory developments. Help Pinnacle IT continue developing repeatable AI security and emerging-technology services, standards, and methodologies. Strong hands-on experience securing and administering Microsoft 365 environments. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, identity and access management, information protection, and Microsoft 365 security controls. Demonstrated ability to independently implement cybersecurity controls and remediate security weaknesses. Strong understanding of identity security, access control, data protection, information governance, endpoint security, authentication, and cybersecurity fundamentals. Minimum of one year of practical experience using, evaluating, administering, securing, or implementing artificial intelligence technologies in a professional or business environment. Working knowledge of generative AI platforms and their associated cybersecurity, privacy, governance, and data-protection risks. Ability to assess business technology use cases and identify cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and operational implications. Strong client-facing communication, consulting, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, technical personnel, and end users. Ability to independently manage technical projects and client engagements from discovery through completion. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, research, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Studio, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure AI Services, or other enterprise AI technologies. Experience conducting cybersecurity risk or security-readiness assessments. Experience with Microsoft data governance, information protection, DLP, sensitivity labeling, and data classification. Experience assessing or securing AI applications, agents, integrations, connectors, or enterprise AI deployments. Experience with NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, HIPAA, CMMC, CJIS, or other cybersecurity and compliance frameworks. Experience working within an MSP, MSSP, consulting organization, or other multi-client technical environment. Relevant cybersecurity, Microsoft, privacy, compliance, governance, or AI security certifications. They understand the client's business objective, identify how existing security weaknesses may create additional risk, and provide a practical path toward secure adoption. Most importantly, this individual has the technical expertise to personally implement the security changes they recommend and takes ownership of client engagements from the initial conversation through successful technical completion. This role is ideal for an experienced cybersecurity professional who has embraced AI, understands its opportunities and risks, enjoys working directly with clients, and wants to help organizations adopt emerging technologies without unnecessarily exposing their systems or data to additional risk.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Manager - Product & Commercial based in Ireland. This role owns the product and commercial direction of a high-volume messaging and verification ecosystem across multiple international markets. You will shape the strategy for SMS, RCS, WhatsApp Business, voice, and verification, balancing reliability, customer experience, speed, and cost. Working at the intersection of Product, Engineering, partnerships, and operations, you will turn messaging infrastructure into a measurable business advantage. You will manage strategic technology and communications partners while driving negotiations, performance, and supplier accountability. A major focus will be improving deliverability, reducing costs, and strengthening routing and failover capabilities for critical customer journeys. You will also bring commercial discipline to messaging economics, using data to guide decisions and influence senior stakeholders. This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who understands A2P communications and thrives in fast-moving, complex emerging markets. Accountabilities Own the messaging and verification product roadmap across multiple markets, balancing reliability, customer experience, cost efficiency, and speed to market while translating business needs into clear priorities. Define channel selection, fallback, routing, retry, and failover strategies for verification, transactional, and promotional communications, partnering closely with Engineering to deliver the required integrations and operational tooling. Evaluate new messaging channels and capabilities based on market availability, permitted use cases, technical feasibility, and measurable business value. Lead the selection, evaluation, and ongoing management of messaging aggregators, CPaaS providers, and other strategic partners, maintaining supplier scorecards and holding vendors accountable for performance and commercial commitments. Negotiate pricing, volume commitments, service levels, payment terms, and contractual protections in collaboration with vendors, Legal, and relevant internal stakeholders. Build a detailed understanding of messaging economics by market, channel, provider, and use case, identifying opportunities to optimize rates, supplier allocation, routing, and channel selection. Own business outcomes related to delivery success, latency, verification completion, and overall messaging performance, using operational data to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Establish reporting that connects provider performance with customer outcomes, lead escalations and incident response, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions when recurring issues arise. Plan supplier capacity and readiness for peak events, major campaigns, and new market launches while reducing supplier concentration risk and maintaining credible alternatives for critical markets. Own messaging spend forecasts and budget performance, tracking cost per delivered message, cost per successful verification, total spend, and volume. Strong practical knowledge of A2P SMS, RCS Business Messaging, and WhatsApp Business, including pricing models, templates and conversations, sender IDs, registration requirements, and related commercial considerations. Demonstrated experience with cost management, vendor negotiations, commercial modeling, and analyzing per-message and per-conversion economics for senior stakeholders. Ability to translate operational and commercial requirements into concise, actionable product and technical requirements that align with broader product and engineering strategies. Deep understanding of messaging performance metrics, including deliverability, latency, verification completion, cost, and provider performance, with the ability to interpret dashboards and turn data into actionable insights. Experience operating across emerging markets in Africa, with an understanding of local regulatory environments and the ability to adapt strategies to different market conditions. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience aligning internal teams, external partners, and senior executives around shared objectives. Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management abilities, combined with strong commercial judgment and ownership. Experience in highly regulated industries is an advantage. Existing relationships with regional communications vendors across Africa are a plus. Familiarity with API documentation, webhooks, integration constraints, and technical dependencies is beneficial. Experience with additional communication channels and tools such as email, push, in-app messaging, USSD, chatbots, conversational AI, or CDPs is a plus. Experience designing or operating multi-vendor routing environments across communications providers is highly desirable. Benefits Opportunity to own the product and commercial direction of a critical messaging and verification ecosystem across multiple international markets. High-impact role with direct influence on customer experience, conversion, operational efficiency, and infrastructure costs. Cross-functional exposure spanning Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Security, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, and external technology partners. Significant ownership over vendor strategy, commercial negotiations, routing, deliverability, and cost optimization.
